Which statements must be correct for an object to be in equilibrium?
1
The object is moving in a straight line.
2
There is no resultant force on the object.
3
There is no resultant moment on the object.
A
1 and 2 only
B
1 and 3 only
C
2 and 3 only
D
1, 2 and 3
subject: Physics
